site_description: Independent software, built to answer to its users. Five principles, each with a test.
commitment_funding_body: The people who use the software are the people who pay for it. No advertisers, no data buyers, no third party whose interests and incentives point in another direction.
commitment_time_body: We don’t compete for your attention. No infinite feeds, no streaks, no notifications designed to pull you back. The software should do its job and let you leave.
commitment_open_body: Everything you put in, you can take out. Complete, automated, in formats other software can read. Leaving should be as easy as joining. Staying should be a choice, not a trap.
commitment_real_body: Each account is held by one verified person, and no one has to reveal who they are to prove it. No bots, no troll factories. Ban someone once and they stay banned.
commitment_infrastructure_body: We build on protocols and formats that no single company owns, including us. What we make can be replaced, forked, or connected to without our permission.
site_blurb: Workshop Europa is an independent, non-profit association dedicated to building open-source digital infrastructure.
about_vision: We believe Europe's digital future should be built on openness, transparency and independence. Essential digital services should be accessible, trustworthy and designed to serve people rather than commercial interests.
about_projects: Through several open-source projects, we develop practical alternatives to proprietary platforms and services, with a focus on privacy, accessibility and European digital sovereignty.
about_founding: Workshop Europa is a registered non-profit association based in Denmark, founded by {founders}.

vionio_summary: A creator platform on open protocols — your audience travels with you.
vionio_funding: Subscriptions, paid by the people posting and the people reading. No advertising, no paid placement, and nothing sold about anyone here.
vionio_time: The feed is what you subscribed to, in the order it arrived. Nobody working on it is measured on time spent.
vionio_open: Your posts, your following and your identity export in one step and land on another server. The protocol is the way out, so leaving needs nothing from us.
vionio_infrastructure: Built on protocols nobody owns, and we don’t operate one. The parts other people depend on are not ours to close.
risved_summary: Open-source European hosting — run it on our cloud or your own hardware.
risved_image_alt: Risved projects dashboard showing apps, frameworks and deployment status.
risved_funding: Hosting fees from the people hosting. No resale of usage data, and the price list is the whole commercial relationship.
risved_open: The control plane is the open-source project. Take the images and the configuration and run the same thing on your own machines.
risved_infrastructure: Every part of the stack is published under a licence that cannot be withdrawn. We sell the operation, not the right to operate.
inlagg_summary: A Nordic social platform where every account is verified with BankID or MitID.
inlagg_image_alt: Inlägg home feed showing posts, replies and reactions from fictional users.
inlagg_funding: A subscription, paid monthly by the people using it. There is no advertiser to answer to because there is no advertising.
inlagg_time: No infinite feed, no streaks, no re-engagement mail. Leaving is one button and takes effect immediately.
inlagg_open: A full export in an open format, including who follows you, ready to import elsewhere without our involvement.
inlagg_real: BankID and MitID issue the proof. What reaches us is that a person stands behind the account, never which person.
idun_summary: An open protocol bridging identity to the federated social web.
idun_funding: Föreningen Idun is funded by its members, who are the people implementing the specification. Nobody buys a say in it.
idun_open: An identity is portable by construction: move it between issuers and services without asking any of them.
idun_real: The proof is issued by a third party and carries one claim — that a person is behind it. Implementers never receive the identity.
idun_infrastructure: Stewarded by a non-profit association whose statutes prevent it from selling or licensing the specification. Implement it without a licence, a fee, or a conversation.
